author: AccessFlow Workstream B
purpose: Local development inventory for weighted multimodal scenarios
evidence_note: Catalog membership is not execution, accuracy, latency, or user-benefit evidence.

provenance.image: Synthetic or injected-provider stimuli; no participant screenshots or recordings.
